name: sidekick
description: A second opinion from Google Gemini inside Claude Code: review, debug, architect, brainstorm. Run /sidekick:setup after installing.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Paste your key right on this line (no separate prompt opens), then press Enter to save. Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored in your system keychain. Leave blank for Google Cloud Agent Platform or a shell-exported key.

service_account_file.title: Service-account key file
service_account_file.description: Only for Google Cloud Agent Platform with a service account: pick its JSON key file. Leave blank for an API key or gcloud login.
